name: data-science-tycoon
description: A web-based WASM/C++ simulation game where players climb the corporate data science ladder

scripts.build:wasm: emcc src/cpp/main.cpp src/cpp/game_state.cpp src/cpp/data_generator.cpp src/cpp/task_system.cpp src/cpp/scorer.cpp src/cpp/economy.cpp -O3 -s WASM=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s ENVIRONMENT=web -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 --bind -o public/wasm/game.js
scripts.build:all: npm run build:wasm && npm run build
